confirmedEvent.description: A confirmed book event for display purposes. Omits cryptographic fields (bookPub, bookSig) and book reference since it's shown in context of a book.

actor.description: The person who performed this event

uri.description: The AT URI of this event record

registrationView.description: A view of a book registration for API responses. Omits cryptographic fields (bookPub, bookSig) and the cover blob.

authors.description: Authors of this book, in order of credit

bookId.description: The book's ID (as defined on its QR Code)

publicationId.description: The book's Open Library Edition ID

registeredBy.description: The person who registered the book

statefulBook.description: A book with its current state, combining registration data with computed state information.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio of the cover image

cid.description: The CID of the book registration record

coverUrl.description: Resolved URL to the cover image (from the registration blob)

currentHolder.description: The DID of the current holder of the book

currentLocation.description: The current location of the book (only present if state is 'org.passingreads.book.drop')

events.description: List of confirmed events for this book, in chronological order

registration.description: The book registration data (without cryptographic fields)

state.description: The current state of the book, derived from the latest event

uri.description: The AT URI of the book registration record
